title: Setup and Studio: suggestions from a full HotCRM browser pass on 18.2.0: user onboarding, packaged automation state, run-now for scheduled flows, admin lists, and Studio entry, field table, flow inspector wording and one designer per item
body:
Suggestions from HotCRM's full browser pass on platform **18.2.0** (hotcrm#2320). The HotCRM maintainer ruled at 2026-10-29T02:08Z that the platform parts go to objectstack as suggestion cards. This card holds Setup and Studio. The console parts are a sibling card.

Each row cites its track report on hotcrm#2320 and the finding id there. Each report's `REPORT.md` has the steps and screenshots. HotCRM is a read-only code package in Studio throughout.

## Setup

| # | Observed on 18.2.0 | Report | Suggestion |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Users → Create User: Permission Set is a free-text box with no picker, and there is no Position field. HotCRM grants access by position. | [Setup](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6442758420) S1 | A permission-set picker and an optional Position picker. |
| 2 | Position → Add holder lists names only. | [Setup](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6442758420) S2 | Show the email beside the name. |
| 3 | Packaged Automation: a green On toggle sits beside "Not running here" for five scheduled flows, and the reason names an environment variable. | [Setup](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6442758420) S3 | A muted toggle, or "On, but scheduled work is off on this deployment" in plain words. |
| 4 | A scheduled flow cannot be run on demand, so an admin cannot check a due-date reminder or a forecast snapshot. | [Revenue](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6444188882) S14 | A "Run now" action for administrators, recorded as a manual run. |
| 5 | Metadata lists (Positions, Permission Sets): singular titles, the API name is the first column, and at 390 px each row is about 180 px tall. | [Setup](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6442758420) S4 | Plural titles, the label first with the API name as subtext, compact rows on a phone. |
| 6 | Users row menu: Edit, Ban, Set Password, Impersonate, Set Manager. No Deactivate. | [Setup](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6442758420) S8 | A Deactivate action named as such. |
| 7 | Approval Requests: the column "Record ID" shows the record's name. | [Setup](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6442758420) S9 | Call it "Record". |
| 8 | A fallback approver's request looks like any other. It does not say the approver got it because the Sales Director position is empty. | [Revenue](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6444188882) S20 | Say on the request why it was routed to the fallback. |
| 9 | Permission set → field overrides lists the internal "Search Index (`__search`)" first. | [Setup](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6442758420) S10 | Hide platform-internal fields. |
| 10 | List Display menu holds Export as CSV / XLSX. | [Setup](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6442758420) S7 | Put Export in the toolbar or the ⋯ menu. |
| 11 | Setup → All reports says "No reports — This app has no reports you can open." | [Setup](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6442758420) S14 | Hide the entry when empty, or point to the apps' reports. |

## Studio

| # | Observed on 18.2.0 | Report | Suggestion |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | Studio is reached only from Home → "Build an app". There is no entry in the app switcher, the account menu or an app's top bar. | [Studio](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443071470) S1 | An admin-only "Open in Studio" in the app switcher and on the app bar, read-only for a code package. |
| 13 | "Read-only · Customize with an overlay" shows on objects, flows and pages, which take no overlay, and lands on the package's All Metadata Types page. | [Studio](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443071470) S2 | Show it only for overlay-able types, landing on that item's designer. |
| 14 | The object designer has no table of fields (API name, type, required, help). | [Studio](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443071470) S3 | A Fields tab with those columns. |
| 15 | Flow node help is engine prose (`submitter_id`, `onEmptyApprovers`), and a placeholder reads "ADR-0105 D9 — organization…". | [Studio](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443071470) S4 | Business wording, with the detail behind "learn more". |
| 16 | The Create Record node cuts field names to 4–5 characters ("subj", "dueD"). | [Studio](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443071470) S5 | Stack field over value, or widen the inspector. |
| 17 | The publish dialog says "Also changed: ~ nodes". | [Studio](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443071470) S6 | Name the node and the property changed. |
| 18 | The flow clone notice is a seven-sentence paragraph with code spans; the toast says "Published 1 package-less flow draft". | [Studio](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443071470) S7 | One line, plus a "switch the original off" button; name the flow in the toast. |
| 19 | Studio and Setup → Metadata each open a designer for the same flow or view (Setup auto-saves); only Setup can delete a flow or reset an overlay. | [Studio](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443071470) S8 | One designer, with delete and reset in Studio. |
| 20 | The navigation tree says "No items in this package" for HotCRM Service and Marketing, while the app shows their contributed entries. | [Studio](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443071470) S9 | Show contributed entries greyed, with their package (related: #26889). |
| 21 | A read-only package's flow Enabled switch is drawn on and green, like a live control. | [Studio](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443071470) S10 | A muted state with a lock. |
| 22 | At phone width the flow canvas opens at 100% and cuts off branch nodes; an object's record cards show the internal "Account Name (Normalized)". | [Studio](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6443071470) S11 | Fit to view on open; card lines from `highlightFields`. |

## Acceptance

Each row is either taken, with its own card if it needs one, or answered "will not do", with the reason.

<sub>Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` lane seat (session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`) from the #2320 UX summary, on the maintainer's ruling. Dedupe: read the titles of every open `domain:ui` card, every `domain:ui` card closed since 2026-10-26, and the open issue list. #26059 lists other Setup gaps (record scope, delegated admin) and none of these. #26889 is related to row 20 but covers Interfaces listing, not the tree.</sub>
